title: Scanning configuration independence from proof data
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean word, $\phi$ a scanning phase, and $r$ a natural number. If $i,i'$ are natural numbers with $i\le |z|$ and $i'\le |z|$, and $i=i'$, then the corresponding scanning configurations are equal regardless of which bound witness is used.
